question: Can known kernel_done_count qualify the patent program length/opcode-check lead?
disposition: Public records expose uint32 kernel_done_count in completion/control contexts, including dynamic-batch switching. No qualified mapping to microcode instruction count, opcode width, CRC polynomial or H10H arithmetic encoding follows. Existing host codecs already preserve these fields; no new serializer or hardware probe is warranted. The bounded local search adds no source-execution capability and is not a universal absence proof.
